priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the socket listener during cleanup
findings.body: The returned cleanup function no longer unregisters `handler`. After cleanup, messages still invoke stale handlers, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners and retain associated state.

findings.title: [P2] Cancel the interval during polling cleanup
findings.body: The interval handle is discarded and the returned cleanup is a no-op. Polling therefore continues after teardown, retaining callback state, performing unwanted refreshes, and potentially keeping a Node.js process alive indefinitely.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns a no-op disposer after registering handler with socket.on at line 2. The full diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler), so detached consumers remain registered; the participant reply provides no source fix.
